name: Nikhil Gudepu
text: Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni Sir is an excellent urologist who treats patients with great care and patience. He listens carefully, explains the problem clearly, and provides the best treatment guidance. The staff at AINU Hospitals are also supportive and professional. I had a very positive experience and would highly recommend Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni Sir to anyone looking for expert urology care in Secunderabad.

name: Harikaa
text: Dr. RAGHAVENDRA KULKARNI is an exceptional surgeon, he handled all the procedures with incredible patience and precision with a reassuring smile. I highly recommend the doctor and grateful for his skill and care!

name: huzefa lokhandwala
text: The way he explained the kidney stone surgery was clear and reassuring. He took time to explain each step of the procedure so I knew exactly what to expect. He answered all my questions about the surgery with patience and detail. He was incredibly calm and patient throughout my treatment. His calm nature helped reduce my anxiety before the surgery.. He’s a very patient doctor who genuinely cares about his patients. The surgery went smoothly thanks to his skill and expertise. I felt I was in safe hands from consultation to recovery. He provided excellent post-surgery guidance for preventing future stones. A skilled, patient, and kind urologist - Dr.Raghavendra Kulkarni made my kidney stone treatment stress-free.

name: Shankar K
text: Dr. Raghavendra treated my father for a kidney condition and performed a PCNL surgery. From diagnosis to post-operative care, he was calm, clear, and thorough. He explained the procedure and risks in simple terms and handled the emergency with confidence. The surgery went smoothly and my father is recovering well. We’re grateful for his expertise and care. Highly recommended.

name: Srikanth Kuncha
text: I had hernia surgery in March month , it’s was a very good recovery thanks to Doctor kulkarni sir and to his team who all have taken care of me had a very fast recovery .

name: Ch V R Srinivasa Rao
text: Dr Kulkarni sir treatment is very good. He is patient listener to our issues. I underwent endoscopic operation for Bladder Stones & Prostate.

name: vijaya laxmi
text: We visited AINU VIKRAMPURI Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni sir for my husband Hernia surgery we had a very positive experience with urologist during the surgery. The doctor was highly professional, explained the procedure clearly, and made us feel comfortable and confident throughout the process. The surgery went smoothly, and the post-operative care was excellent. I truly appreciate the doctor’s skill, patience, and dedication. I would highly recommend him to anyone in need of urological care.

name: Sheetal N Pendyala
text: I have been regularly consulting Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni for my parents aged 77 and 86 years respectively. I am fully confident that both my parents are in safe hands. At home, in all our conversations they have told that Dr. R. Kulkarni listens with patience, is comfortable to talk to and respects patient’s viewpoints. He is one of the competent urologists in Vikrampuri, Secunderabad area, which is a major advantage as it reduces travel time for us. For my 86 y/o parent, I had to urgently address benign prostrate hyperplasia issue as medications did not give positive results. Given advanced age and existing health conditions, I was confused and nervous whether other medical procedures will provide long-term relief. During this dilemma phase, Dr. R. Kulkarni clearly explained both to me and to the patient – how the condition had progressed, why medicine alone is not working, better treatment options (advanced & traditional procedures) available for senior citizens, and the likely expenses to incur. Very importantly he imparted confidence that this condition can be fully treated in an 86 y/o. Given Dr. R. Kulkarni’s knowledge on the subject and his confidence levels I opted for an advanced medical procedure in March 2026; the procedure seems to have worked as the patient is currently in good health condition.

name: Rakshit Shah
text: We recently had my father treated for kidney stones at AINU Hospitals, Secunderabad under Dr. Raghavendra Kulkarni, and I just wanted to share my experience. Dr. Kulkarni was very clear and straightforward in explaining the condition and treatment options, which really helped us stay calm and make informed decisions. He’s approachable, patient, and takes the time to answer questions without rushing. The overall experience at AINU was smooth—from admission to treatment and post-care. The staff and ICU team were attentive and supportive throughout, and the coordination (including with insurance) was handled well. Grateful for the care my father received. Would definitely recommend Dr. Kulkarni and AINU for anyone dealing with kidney stones or related issues.
